<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine: Jawa Camp''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ジャワのキャンプ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトサイド：自分のジャワはすべて戦闘力と没収値が－１。ダークサイド：ジャワを配備する際、自分のフォースを１消費するだけでよい。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-292o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Jawa Camp.

'''Card text:''' Light Side: All of your Jawas are power and forfeit -1. Dark Side: You need use only 1 Force to deploy a Jawa.

'''Lore:''' 

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese spends 1 Force to deploy a Jawa; the English deploys Jawas here for 1 Force from you only.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Jawa Camp (Dark)|Tatooine: Jawa Camp]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100.
